title: negundo nuttallii
intro: Negundo nuttallii, commonly known as Black walnut, is a deciduous tree native to North America, belonging to the family Juglandaceae. The health benefits of Negundo nuttallii include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve skin conditions, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Negundo nuttallii include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiparasitic effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. Negundo nuttallii contains bioactive constituents such as juglone, a lignan, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
